QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set, the compiler defines `__GNUC__` (or is ARMCC ≥ 6), and the architecture is one of the four above (`constant_time_impl.h:40-52`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros (`__GNUC__`, architecture), which shows it is derived. It treats only HAVE_ASM as a config opt-out, not CT_ASM.
